digest.component_or_area: IAM and Bedrock integration for review-bot container
propositions: The review-bot container lacks IAM permissions to invoke Bedrock, blocked by missing bedrock:InvokeModel and bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream actions scoped to Claude foundation models and cross-region inference profiles.

The original plan incorrectly identified bedrock:Converse as the required action; runtime evidence from the instance proved the Converse API authorizes against bedrock:InvokeModel, not a distinct Converse action.
IMDSv2 token requests from inside the review-bot container succeed, selecting the IAM-only remediation path without requiring hop-limit changes to metadata_options.

The grant must be scoped with both region and model-prefix wildcards (bedrock:* region, *.anthropic.claude-* profile prefix) to support cross-region inference profiles including global. prefixed profiles.
